_about: This app's PRODUCTION chat flags, for the replay pack (src/app/api/chat/replay-pack). 'on': read as on in Vercel production. 'assumedOn': encrypted or not visible to the Vercel reader (it lists 100 of 181 entries), taken as on from QA's 26 Oct decrypted reading and the replays that match production. 'off': known off. QA messages every flag flipped; update this file in the same pull request as the change it tests. Only *_ENABLED chat flags; integrations (Woven, Google reviews) are left out. 5 Nov 2026 (QA; Pau's Vercel Agent read, 179 *_ENABLED rows, 49/49 plain values cross-checked against QA's API read): corrected to production — 5 assumedOn are OFF (CONVERSATION_DRAFT_REUSE, DRAFT_ACTIONS, GROUNDED_ENTITIES, PROMPT_CACHE, REMAP_DRAFT_SOURCES), 2 'off' are ON (ANSWER_NOT_A_NAME, STORE_WORD_NOT_A_NAME), 48 ON flags were missing; the explicit OFF values are listed in 'off'. SELF_CHECK_ENABLED is unset in Vercel (= off) and stays in 'off'. WOVEN_SYNC_WRITES is left out (sensitive).
